title: Commission publishes simplification review of EU Deforestation Regulation
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 04 May 2026 Today, the Commission published a report on the simplification of the revised EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) and a set of further measures for a smooth and effective implementation following the agreement of co-legislators last December.

title: Commission evaluation shows slow progress in fishing sustainability and ongoing challenges for EU fishers
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Apr 2026 The European Commission today published its evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy (CFP) Regulation, covering the decade from 2014 to 2024.
